title: MG-REPA: Multi-Granularity Representation Alignment for Generative Target Speaker Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.32161v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative target speaker extraction (TSE) models achieve high-quality extraction, but suffer from considerably slow training convergence. Representation Alignment (REPA) accelerates diffusion transformer training by aligning hidden states with a pre-trained Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) teacher. However, existing alignment in the speech and audio domain operates at a single granularity. For TSE, frame-level alignment leaves the global, time-invariant characteristics of the target speech implicit, whereas utterance-level alignment leaves the time-varying content implicit, even though extracting the target requires both. We propose Multi-Granularity Representation Alignment (MG-REPA), aligning the hidden states with an SSL model at the frame level and a speaker verification model at the utterance level. translated_title: MG-REPA：面向生成式目标说话人提取的多粒度表示对齐
translated_abstract: 生成式目标说话人提取（TSE）模型能够实现高质量的提取效果，但其训练收敛速度相当缓慢。表示对齐（REPA）通过将隐藏状态与预训练的自监督学习（SSL）教师模型对齐来加速扩散Transformer的训练。然而，现有的语音与音频领域中的对齐方法仅在单一粒度上进行操作。对于TSE而言，帧级对齐使得目标语音的全局、时不变特性保持隐式状态，而话语级对齐则使时变内容保持隐式状态，尽管提取目标说话人两者都需要。我们提出多粒度表示对齐（MG-REPA），在帧级将隐藏状态与SSL模型对齐，并在话语级与说话人验证模型对齐。我们进一步对帧级目标应用时间归一化，去除其话语级统计信息，使每个分支专注于……
tldr: 提出多粒度表示对齐方法MG-REPA，通过在帧级与SSL模型对齐、在话语级与说话人验证模型对齐，同时捕获目标语音的时变内容和全局说话人特征，从而加速生成式目标说话人提取模型的训练收敛。
en_tdlr: MG-REPA accelerates the training convergence of generative target speaker extraction by aligning hidden states with an SSL model at the frame level and a speaker verification model at the utterance level, capturing both time-varying content and global speaker characteristics.
